cultivar: Local population plants and other cultivars suited to the appellation
processing: Green tea, with the enzymes fixed by heat and no oxidation. Both a flat shape and a tight pellet shape are described under this name.
harvest_season: Exact dates are little documented; as with other Guizhou greens, spring is the main and most prized picking.
appearance_dry: Flat and jade green in the commonly described style; a tight, heavy, glossy pellet form is also described.
appearance_wet: Little is documented; typical of tender greens, an even fresh green leaf.
taste_profile: Fresh and brisk with a lasting young-leaf aroma; the pellet style is described as fuller and sweeter, with a noticeable floral note.

brewing.notes: General guidance for a mountain green. Pellets need a little longer than flat leaf to open on the first steep.

vintage_note: Usual for Chinese greens: sold as the current year's spring harvest and best drunk within about a year. Nothing suggests it is aged or sold by vintage.
description:
Jiucengshan tea is a protected green from Liuzhi Special District in Liupanshui, western Guizhou, named after Jiuceng Mountain and tied especially to Langdai town.

The mountain gardens are the point of the tea. Accounts put them high up, from about 1,200 to 1,600 metres depending on the description, with frequent cloud and selenium-bearing soil. The gardens run close to the Jiucengshan forest park above the Zangke River valley.

The cup is described as bright green, fresh and brisk, with a young-leaf scent that lasts. A pellet version is said to be fuller and sweeter with a clearer floral note. Brew it as you would other tender greens, with water that has cooled a little.

Because two shapes share the name, check which you are getting, and ask for the picking date. Any selenium claim on the pack is best taken as marketing unless backed by a test result.
history: Little is documented about how the tea developed. The clear date is 8 December 2017, when the national quality inspection authority approved geographical indication protection, with the production area set as the whole of Liuzhi Special District.
